caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden hand plane depicted in a realistic style. The hand plane consists primarily of two main parts: a rectangular, block-shaped wooden body and an angled blade protruding from the top. The wooden body is brown with visible wood grain and natural imperfections, including small cracks and a knot. The top surface of the body features a carved, decorative pattern that includes curved lines, a circular rust-colored metal nail or fastener, and an inscribed motif resembling a letter "A" and the number "4". The blade is a rusty, dark brown color and is inserted into the hand plane at an angle, held in place by a wedge piece, which itself has a circular, engraved design resembling a flower or sunburst. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Plane
